executionScope: Eleven directed cases passed across three full-pack QA runs; the initial chisel stability assertion failed before its fixture correction. All 40 isolated GameTests and 53 JUnit tests passed. Only the QA fixture changed afterward, and qaJar was rebuilt; unrelated full-pack cases were not rerun.

coverage.habitation: Six cases exercise native bed interaction, check-in/checkout, preserved home tuple and bed, unchanged early campaign, incomplete/obstructed rejection, safe non-forced native respawn, fluid/obstruction refusal, independent module removal, broken lodging, replacement by a valid bed, native event fallback to the original bed, clone/NBT roundtrip, later-bed precedence, canceled entry/checkout/clone setters and another mod's explicit no-copy decision.
coverage.journalRegression: Two existing cases verify team-specific read-only journal packets and recoverable module batch deposits after adding the personal lodging view.
coverage.mechanicalChisel: Native processing capability and Chipped filter; 12 unpowered ticks conserve input, then a real Create creative motor supplies 32 RPM to the same unstressed network. One stone becomes one carved stone, and the same single ItemEntity remains after 40 powered ticks. This is a QA power fixture, not finite-fuel balance evidence.
coverage.teamRestart: Three internally connected players in two real FTB parties log out normally. Distinct personal histories, party membership, different actual partial Ark deposits and exact inventories survive a normal stop and new JVM. Both teams complete their remaining batch independently; replay and a foreign campaign ID consume nothing. Act-six/module eligibility is seeded QA state, not a natural playthrough.

firstFailures.observation: The native recipe and initial single output passed, but after 40 ticks the small observation box was empty.
firstFailures.causeAndCorrection: Pinned native code ejects the item along Z. The empty fixture lacked a receiving floor. Added five stone floor blocks beneath that path and required the same output UUID at the final no-duplication check; the corrected case passed. No production recipe, mod or kinetic balance was changed.

limitations: No Computer Use or client launch; bilingual rendering, final artwork and client acceptance remain pending.

Lodging tests invoke native selection/events/clone and serialize player NBT; they do not execute a complete human network death session. Anchor charge, End-return edge cases, cold chunk-boundary behavior and every third-party respawn handler were inspected in source but not directly exercised here. Lodging itself was not the two-process fixture.
Team restart uses internal mock network connections and seeded late-act eligibility; human co-op, six external clients, natural acquisition and pacing remain pending.
No gameplay FPS/MSPT, two-hour soak or industrial-base performance acceptance is claimed.

Nature, exploration and logistics still lack selected complete practical services. Final mod/quest scale, first-hour gate, full campaign playthrough, approved public release and weekly-review acceptance remain open.

Active unrelated processes and Codex databases were not modified.
